models.user: The currently logged-in woman using the platform — her profile, language preference, and whether she has completed the initial onboarding steps.
models.onboardingSteps: The guided setup checklist shown to first-time users. Each step points to a section of the app. Once all steps are completed, the checklist disappears from the Dashboard.
models.metrics: A snapshot of the user's key activity numbers — how much she earned this month, how many orders are waiting, how many courses she is actively taking, and the current status of her loan.
models.streak: Tracks how many consecutive days the user has been active on the learning platform, including her all-time longest streak.
models.milestones: Badges and achievements the user has earned — such as completing her first course, making her first sale, or reaching an earnings target. Unearned milestones show as locked.
models.nextGoal: A single contextual nudge card telling the user the most impactful next action she can take, based on her lowest-engagement section.
models.agentActions: A feed of recent actions taken by the AI agent on the user's behalf — such as listing products, enrolling in courses, or submitting loan applications.
models.recommendations: Forward-looking AI suggestions to help the user grow — such as adding more product photos, completing a module, or applying for a larger loan.
models.announcements: Banners and alert cards from the platform (new features, policy updates) and personalized notifications (loan repayment reminders, order alerts, course deadlines).

relationships: metrics references the User's active Loan (via loanStatus and activeLoanBalance)
metrics references the User's pending Orders (via pendingOrdersCount)
metrics references the User's enrolled Courses (via activeCoursesCount)
onboardingSteps link to sections of the app using the targetSection field
agentActions and recommendations each carry a targetSection to enable deep navigation
announcements with type 'personalized' are scoped to the individual user; type 'platform' are broadcast to all users
